title: One Federation Agent Card extension declaration
description: The A2A v1.0 AgentExtension entry an agent lists in its Agent Card `capabilities.extensions`. The extension is a profile extension and is required: a client that does not activate it (A2A-Extensions header) is refused with ExtensionSupportRequiredError.

schemaVersions.description: Extension schema versions the agent accepts; peers use the highest common one.

kinds.description: Typed message kinds the agent accepts.

capabilities.description: Taxonomy capabilities usable as typed bodies, as capability negotiation declarations; negotiated by intersection and highest common version.
